decode: BC7 base mip decoded to PNG with sRGB code values preserved; local preview generates its own mipmaps
mapping: Selective triplanar grayscale, 60 metres per repeat by default. Runtime samples grayscale directly and multiplies by material_RockColor in linear space.
material: Shader Color is the only rock pigment and overall albedo control; white shows the normalized light grayscale texture, darker colors reduce its albedo. Native lighting, cavity shading and grass coverage remain independent.
processing: Original RGB decoded from sRGB to linear; Rec.709 luminance (0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B); divided by the measured source peak luminance so the brightest texel is white; encoded back to sRGB and stored as 8-bit grayscale + original alpha PNG. Uniform linear scaling preserves relative luminance without clipping, resampling or added contrast.
